title: Fantasy Items 1:Cursed Finger
description: Adds a new food with fantasy
body:
# 🧙‍♂️ Fantasy Items: Cursed Finger 🖤

☠️ Step into a dark fantasy world where every touch can change fate!
## This mod adds:

## 🖤 Cursed Finger 
A mysterious finger imbued with unpredictable magical powers. Handle it carefully, as it can curse or empower you in surprising ways.

## 🔮 Fantasy Artifacts 
Ancient, enchanted items that bring chaos, magic, and adventure to your world.

## 🗡 Dark Effects – each item can trigger unique and dangerous effects. Will you risk it?

## 💡 Features:

⚡ Each Cursed Finger has random magical outcomes

🏹 Combine artifacts for powerful, chaotic combos

🎲 Risk-reward gameplay – the more you dare, the more you gain (or lose!)

🌌 Perfect for players who love a mysterious, challenging twist

## 🎮 How to Install:

Place the mod in your mods folder

Launch Minecraft

Explore, experiment, and embrace the curses… 😈

## ✨ Warning: These items are unpredictable and dangerous — not recommended for the faint of heart!
